title: Un demi setier!
html_source: A demi-setier was an ancient measurement of liquid used mainly in France.

anchor.prefix: n Egan rolls gunpowder cigarettes through fingers smeared with printer's ink, sipping his green fairy as Patrice his white. About us gobblers fork spiced beans down their gullets.
anchor.suffix: A jet of coffee steam from the burnished caldron. She serves me at his beck. Il est irlandais. Hollandais? Non fromage. Deux irlandais, nous, Irlande, 1961#42vous savez? Ah, oui!
